Logisim-evolution circuits for the Arquitectura de computadoras course at Universidad Anáhuac México Norte.
Each folder is one practice with its own README.

| Practice | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`maya`](maya) | DC from binary to Maya numerals on a 4×7 LED matrix. |
| [`seven-segments`](seven-segments) | Base-10 and base-16 decoders for a seven-segment display. |

## Getting Started
Install [Logisim-evolution](https://github.com/logisim-evolution/logisim-evolution/releases) 4.1.0 or later, then
`git clone https://github.com/Freddy-Nader/ac-circuits.git` and open the `.circ` in any practice folder.
